purpose: Deterministic audit trail for reviewed 2026-10-13 research patches.

metadata.scope: Primary-manual-backed H1/H2 creature ability identities and CreatureAbility junctions. No ordinary attacks are modeled as abilities; all descriptive codes are project codes, not native game IDs.
metadata.policy: No cumulative JSON, schema, generated SQL, or live database was edited. Ability effects remain NULL because the current JSON contract reserves AbilityHOMM1.Effect, AbilityHOMM2.Effect, and CreatureAbility.Parameters; source-proven mechanics are retained in canonical Ability.Description and junction evidence.

supports: Wolf attacks twice; Troll regenerates; Cyclops paralyzes and attacks two spaces; Paladin attacks twice; Sprite/Rogue/Hydra prevent retaliation; Dwarf has 25% magic resistance; Elf fires two shots; Unicorn blinds; Phoenix and Dragon attack two spaces; Griffin unlimited retaliation; Dragon spell immunity; Genie halves an enemy group 10%; Ghost creates a Ghost for each creature killed.

locators: Necromancer pp.78-80; Sorceress pp.81-83; Warlock pp.84-86; Wizard pp.87-89; Neutral pp.90-92
supports: Primary manual tables explicitly describe the H2 mechanics represented in this patch, including undead scope, curse chances, life drain, death cloud, elemental immunities/vulnerabilities, and special attacks.
The user-supplied H1/H2 official manuals are registered as manual.c1d7c0b2da69 and manual.a99f53fdd378; retained observations identify the editions and page scope.
AbilityHOMM1.Effect, AbilityHOMM2.Effect, and CreatureAbility.Parameters are reserved JSON contracts; NULL is the only safe value until a structured mechanic schema is approved.

metadata.scope: Original-manual-backed starting HeroSkill junctions for the 54 normal recruitable Heroes II heroes. CampaignOnly and MapOnly heroes are excluded; HeroClassHOMM2.StartingSkills remains unfilled.
metadata.policy: No cumulative catalog, schema, generated SQL, or live database was edited. The manual class defaults are materialized as HeroSkill foreign-key rows for Recruitable heroes only. No class JSON profile is invented.

locators: printed p.44 / PDF page 45, Types table
printed pp.40-43 / PDF pages 41-44, Hero Screen and class context
supports: The Types table says heroes start with class-specific attributes and skills: Barbarian Advanced Pathfinding; Knight Basic Ballistics and Basic Leadership; Necromancer Basic Wisdom and Basic Necromancy; Sorceress Basic Wisdom and Advanced Navigation; Warlock Basic Wisdom and Advanced Scouting; Wizard Advanced Wisdom.
The current catalog contains 54 HeroHOMM2 rows with Availability Recruitable, exactly nine in each of the six classes; 19 CampaignOnly and four MapOnly rows are excluded.
HeroSkill stores the game, hero, skill, and non-null Mastery foreign-key path; the existing H3 rows establish the project-wide junction representation.

metadata.notes: Portable merge patch extracted from the developer-supported Heroes V (3.1) manual hero roster pages 11-69. It fills only supported HeroHOMM5 scalar starts, starting-spell FKs, and HeroSkill rows. It does not edit the cumulative catalog or infer class defaults. Coverage: 106 unique manual hero names, 18 current H5 identities not represented in these pages, 412 scalar fills, 44 starting-spell fills, and 207 HeroSkill additions. Same-name conflicts are preserved in sources.md.

sources.notes: Selective byte-range extraction used read-manual-pages.py in small page ranges; the 58 MB manual was not downloaded in full. Visual pages were inspected for the four stat icons, Skills & Abilities, and Army & Spells labels. No forums or mod wikis were used.
The existing catalog intentionally shares same-name hero identities across ruleset/class forms. Conflicting same-name forms are not duplicated or merged into invented class defaults.

deferred.reason: HOTRAITS.TXT has three probability-bearing native slots and includes war machines. The current JSON contract stores creature ranges but not slot inclusion chances or non-creature war machines; importing a partial array would change the meaning.
These JSONB columns are deliberately null-only in the current contract. The H3C/H3M files support typed data, but importing it first requires reviewed closed JSON shapes and validator tests.

summaryPolicy.method: Newly worded mechanical summaries preserve explicit values, targets, durations, chances, limits and action-continuation qualifiers without reproducing article prose.
summaryPolicy.sourceConfidence: All staged relations use dated official article revisions with seven matching creature stats; that is strong corroboration, not proof of complete build identity.

discoveries.finding: The architecture requires AstrologyHOMM8.AstrologyPointResource_id and InsightResource_id, but the shared Resource catalog lacks parents for native astrology_exp and starDust. The official initial Cargo pages prove those source IDs existed on 2026-05-13, while the retained build-25061458 spell extractor also reads starDust costs.
discoveries.impact: AstrologyHOMM8 cannot satisfy its FKs without adding source-backed shared Resource and GameResource parents or changing the model.

discoveries.finding: AstrologyHOMM8 requires a unique NeutralMagicSchool_id, while the retained build extractor deliberately creates only Daylight, Nightshade, Arcane and Primal schools and leaves neutral spells without an invented fifth school.
discoveries.impact: Do not fabricate a neutral-school parent. Reconcile the schema requirement with the actual source model before inserting AstrologyHOMM8.

discoveries.finding: Official Cargo indices are game-derived, but the accessible initial revisions are dated 2026-05-13 and the current CargoCoverage page says it represents the latest extract.
discoveries.impact: Native IDs can corroborate identity continuity; current numerical balance and ability membership cannot be asserted as build 25061458 without a matching revision or retained raw source.

discoveries.finding: Official game-data revisions for Angel and Archangel are dated 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-02 and expose native active/passive ability IDs. These dates closely flank the 2026-09-29 target snapshot, but the pages do not state the source Steam build.
discoveries.impact: This is a viable low-download source for creature ability identities once its extraction revision is tied to build 25061458. It is not yet sufficient to populate all 146 creatures or required ability mechanics.

discoveries.finding: The official Angel article revision from 2026-08-06 predates the target and its six retained combat values match build 25061458 exactly (225 HP, 30 Attack, 30 Defense, 50-75 Damage, 8 Initiative, 4 Speed). Its active/passive and attack/movement mechanics are therefore strongly aligned for this sampled creature.
discoveries.impact: The official wiki can support source-backed creature abilities without a full game download, but the sample does not establish version alignment for every unit or justify bulk inference.

sources.facts: All 108 released faction heroes, their specialization names, and resolved English mechanics.

Neutral Magic is a source-defined school; this revision enumerates the fourteen staged spell memberships.
